Delivery Days:
We ship from Monday through Saturday. Please note we do not deliver on sundays. 

Delivery Fees:
A delivery fee is applied to all orders based on your location within Dubai and other emirates.

Delivery Timeframes:

  • Same Day Delivery for orders placed before 11 AM (excluding Sundays) in Dubai.
  • Next Day Delivery for orders placed after 11 AM in Dubai 
  • Delivery to Other Emirates: Please allow 2 working days for deliveries to other emirates.

Delivery FAQs

How can I request delivery on a specific date & time?
Include any special requests, delivery dates, and times in the order notes. If you missed it at checkout, send us a message on WhatsApp, and we'll make a note for you.

How do I make changes to my order?
Contact us, and we'll do our best to accommodate any changes.

What are your delivery hours?
Our delivery team typically delivers between 10 AM and 7 PM. If you require your order to be delivered before a specific time, please don't hesitate to contact us, and we'll make arrangements to accommodate your request.

If you have any further questions or concerns about our shipping policy, feel free to contact our customer support team at hello@nodoughbakery.com

Please note that our shipping policies are subject to change at any time without prior notice.
